scope: Public Bruker Python packaging, isolated runtime/mock and synthetic-fixture QA only
public_source_line_endings: Python/JSON build inputs normalized LF for portable Git checkout. Original byte hashes retained; original/public LF-normalized content hashes distinguish formatting from scientific changes. Scientific core, generator and autorun source content equality is tested after LF normalization.

jython.execution: Isolated Java/Jython runtime from the locally installed TopSpin distribution; TopCmds simulated, spectrometer/application not started

bundle_rebuild.check: Source-only rebuild byte-identical for generated engine, v2, v3 and relative SHA-256 build manifest

fresh_git_checkout.method: Local temporary source-only Git snapshot and fresh clone with core.autocrlf=true; repository .gitattributes applied, all six offline groups rerun, Git status clean afterwards. No GitHub/network push or external workspace dependency.

safety_checks: All 69-ramp destinations explicit, collisions rejected before write
Raw/processed data not copied when preparing parameters; template restoration and unexpected-copy checks
Both shipped JSON examples are blocked (example_only=true)
CLI output must be new and outside the experimental dataset; original synthetic-file SHA-256 unchanged
Reference identity, source, solvent, Dref(T) and pulse-program mapping explicitly required; no default experimental calibration
Jython v3 hardware path opt-in after UI confirmation; synchronous completion status verified; unknown/failed status stops
P90/nutation finite, positive-time, signed-signal, bounded-optimum and sweep-span guards checked
No raw data or private calibration profile/paths in distributed bundle; public model identity hashes only
limitations: No real acquisition or native TopSpin application execution in this repository QA
TopSpin 3.6.4 compatibility remains unverified on that application/instrument
Other Python/Jython/TopSpin versions are not claimed tested
GUI is supplied but native visual/manual usability QA was not performed in this packaging turn
Physical gradient proposal is conditional on exact saved pulse/shape identity and the documented local sequence model; not universal or independent physical validation
High R2 does not establish purity, SNR, absence of convection or correct thermometry
No RF tuning, shimming, relaxation-time determination, hardware limits selection or automatic global calibration updates
